yt.title: YouTube
yt.sub: Your channel, your videos and the products they show — and the orders each video brought through its links.
yt.note: Put each product's tracked link in the video's description. An order placed through it is counted for that video. Nothing is posted to YouTube and no money is spent.
yt.offBody: Turn it on in the settings card at the bottom of this page.
yt.offAsk: Ask the owner or a manager to turn the YouTube module on.
yt.keyNote: Views and new uploads are read from YouTube once its key is in Keys & connections (coming later); until then you add videos by their links.

videos.noProducts: No product tied yet: add its products to get the tracked links.

addVideo.title: Title
addVideo.products: Products it shows (product page links or slugs, one per line)

card.d: Off as shipped. The tags go on every tracked link; change them only before you paste links.
card.onHelp: While off nothing can be added; the page only reads.
card.utmSourceHelp: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
card.utmMediumHelp: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
card.campaignPrefixHelp: e.g. yt- gives yt-<video id>; may be empty.
card.readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them needs the right to write campaigns.

err.STALE: Someone changed this; reload the page.
err.forbidden: You do not have the right for this.
